title: Primal Reset Retreats | Return to What Is Real
description: A seven-day retreat on Hawaiʻi Island helping men rebuild confidence after divorce and feel comfortable forming genuine connections with women again.

texts.value: Spend seven days on Hawaiʻi Island rebuilding your confidence, presence, and direction—with honest feedback and guided practice to help you feel comfortable connecting with women again.

texts.value: You still work. You still handle your responsibilities. You still show up. But divorce can quietly shake the way you see yourself.

texts.label: Maybe you hesitate around women, replay conversations, or wonder
texts.value: Maybe you hesitate around women, replay conversations, or wonder whether your confidence will return. Primal Reset gives you space to practice real connection and become comfortable being yourself again.

texts.value: In the Connection Lab, you practice a real conversation with a woman coach. She reflects your posture, voice, eye contact, pace, attention, and emotional presence. You make an adjustment, and then you try again.

texts.value: Open Gate is an off-grid basecamp set directly on cooled lava fields on Hawaiʻi Island's southeastern coast. Accommodations are simple and communal rather than resort-style, surrounded by volcanic earth, jungle, and ocean.
